sources.title: NSK Magnetic Clutch Bearings for A/C Compressor
sources.verified: Manufacturer table identifies30BD40, bore30mm, outside diameter55mm, width23mm, FordFS10/FX15 application; cross-referenceNACHI30BG05S5G-2DS. Introductory text identifies thin-section double-row angular-contact ball-bearing architecture and outer-ring rotation.
sources.not_established: Installed bearing brand/suffix, ball count, ball diameter, pitch circles, contact angle, raceway sections, cage count/shape, seal profiles and fit tolerances.

sources.title: NACHI BG Type for Car Air Conditioning Magnetic Clutch, NAB0302-3
sources.verified: Manufacturer identifies double-row angular-contact architecture, glass-reinforced polyamide cage, seals and grease. Its30BG05S5G-2DS table and test description confirm30×55×23mm. Test setup specifies outer-ring rotation.
sources.not_established: No verified element count, cage count or internal manufacturing dimensions. Performance test claims are not modeled and do not establish truck-specific loads.

sources.title: Firsthand1998 Crown Victoria FS10 dissection: bearing evidence limits
sources.verified: Author explicitly warns that some clutch-bearing balls are missing. Therefore the exposed failed bearing cannot establish the original ball count. Separate thrust washers and roller-bearing assemblies are described and photographed.
sources.not_established: Truck-specific thrust-bearing dimensions, roller counts, cage details, radial shaft-support identity or bearing interchange. This is a1998 nontruck comparison, not the installed1994 unit.

model_reconciliation.required_interface_changes: A separate candidate must reconcile the front-head nose, pulley bearing seat, retaining ring and coil-carrier clearance around the dimensioned bearing. Do not merely resize the bearing inside incompatible accepted interfaces.
model_reconciliation.supported_decomposition: Inner race, outer race, two ball rows and sealed construction are supported architecturally; polyamide cage material is supported for the NACHI comparison. Exact rolling-element and cage counts remain unresolved.
model_reconciliation.prohibited_shortcut: Do not infer a full ball count from the failed dissection photograph, generic catalog illustrations or a desired CAD packing pattern. Do not claim bearing completion from a toroidal rolling-element placeholder.
model_reconciliation.shaft_supports: Two thrust stacks remain supported by the existing comparison photograph, but their individual roller count and radial shaft-support construction require additional direct evidence.

candidate.integration: Call ac_compressor_bearing.build((define,add,group)) instead of ac_compressor_motion.build. This wraps the accepted generator without modifying it and preserves all61IDs and motion groups.
candidate.provisional_seats: Bearing center localX99.7, faces88.2/111.2;29.8mm nose diameter;55.1mm pulley seat bore. Nose end111.1, retaining-ring center111.7, reduced armature neck29.6mmOD. Shaft seal/retainer move rearward into the existing counterbore, coil carrier clears the new bearing seat. All axial stations and fit clearances are illustrative.
candidate.preserved: 145mm clutch outside diameter, normalized six-groove band and belt center,0.6mm armature face gap, external mount ears, all piston/shoe motion and connected refrigerant routes.
candidate.completion_limit: The bearing remains one solid cartridge envelope. No new fabricated ball/cage counts or asserted internal completion.

validation.scope: Eight replacement solids checked against all compressor parts in eight poses, both existing open passage probes, actual shared API transforms at reference/engaged/disengaged poses, and frozen installed neighbors. Unchanged parts inherit the accepted compressor checks.
